color.note: Light is warm paper; dark is deep navy designed on purpose, not inverted. Every text pair listed in a usage note meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Blueprint navy, from the B mark. The brand anchor: the 'handled for you' panel, logo tiles, and the light-theme solid. Customer-branded screens override this one token with the DJ company's primary color.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Brand panels that sit on the page ground (the 'handled for you' panel). Text on it is always text-on-brand.

tokens.name: text-on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and brand-deep fills.

tokens.name: text-on-brand-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on brand and brand-deep fills (10:1 on brand).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background in every Blueprint screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, sheets and message bubbles on paper.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet fills inside a surface: date tiles, hover states, the unfilled part of tracks and bars, the workspace switcher.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows inside a surface. Decorative only; never the only way to show a boundary that matters.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on paper, surface, surface-soft and every tint. Also the default icon color.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Body copy and secondary text on paper, surface, surface-soft and every tint (7:1 or better).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Dates, captions, hints and inactive nav labels on paper, surface, surface-soft and every tint (4.8:1 or better). Never for anything the user must act on.

tokens.name: solid
tokens.usage: Motif: SOLID = proven or done. Fills completed journey stages, current leads in a seat map, verified competencies, and primary buttons. Always paired with a text label.

tokens.name: text-on-solid
tokens.usage: Text on solid fills: primary buttons, filled seats, the selected nav tab.

tokens.name: hatch
tokens.usage: Motif: HATCHED = in progress. The diagonal line color of the .bp-hatch pattern. Always paired with a text label such as 'In progress'.

tokens.name: hatch-soft
tokens.usage: Faint hatch for the empty remainder of bars (recruiting funnel). Decorative.

tokens.name: draft
tokens.usage: Motif: DRAFTED = planned, not started. Construction lines of the .bp-drafted frame (lines overshoot the corners like the B mark). Always paired with a text label such as 'Planned'.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Secondary accent and the important-action color: one coral button per view at most, notification pips, the hatched highlight under a key word. Text on coral is always text-on-coral.

tokens.name: text-on-coral
tokens.usage: Text on coral fills (4.8:1 light, 6.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: coral-text
tokens.usage: Coral used AS text: links, kickers, date-tile month labels, Undo. On paper, surface and surface-soft. Also the focus ring color.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Tint for celebration and advancement moments (a DJ ready to advance). Text on it: ink, ink-2, muted, blush-ink.

tokens.name: blush-ink
tokens.usage: Labels, chips and portrait initials on blush (6.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Tint for hiring and new-applicant moments; also 'needs attention, not urgent'. Text on it: ink, ink-2, muted, butter-ink.

tokens.name: butter-ink
tokens.usage: Labels, chips and initials on butter (7:1 or better).

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Tint for success and 'on track'. Text on it: ink, ink-2, muted, mint-ink.

tokens.name: mint-ink
tokens.usage: Labels, chips and initials on mint (6.3:1 or better).

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Tint for nudges, reminders and informational moments. Text on it: ink, ink-2, muted, sky-ink.

tokens.name: sky-ink
tokens.usage: Labels, chips and initials on sky (8:1 or better).

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Tint for training content and courses. Text on it: ink, ink-2, muted, lavender-ink.

tokens.name: lavender-ink
tokens.usage: Labels, chips and initials on lavender (7.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Tint for errors and blocked states only. Always with a word ('Overdue', 'Couldn't save') and an icon, never color alone.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on danger, surface and paper (6.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: confetti-1
tokens.usage: Celebration burst only (advancement approved, hire made).

tokens.name: confetti-2
tokens.usage: Celebration burst only.

tokens.name: confetti-3
tokens.usage: Celebration burst only.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, 3px offset, on every interactive element. 5:1 or better on paper, surface and every tint.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The one greeting at the top of a home screen. 46px on phones.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: A feature panel's headline (spring readiness). 33px on phones.

styles.name: heading-l
styles.usage: Section headings on a page. 29px on phones.

styles.name: heading-m
styles.sample: Jake is ready to become an Assistant DJ
styles.usage: Card titles: decision cards, idea cards. 24px on phones.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The 'Blueprint' wordmark beside the B mark. Nowhere else.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Three things need you today. Everything else is moving along nicely.
styles.usage: The one-sentence summary under a greeting. 18px on phones.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Three observed events, every requirement backed by evidence.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Sat · Luis leads with Sarah Kim beside him
styles.usage: Supporting lines under a title; event subtitles. Never below 14px for sentences.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, status tags and kickers. Bold so small labels stay legible on tints.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Journey stage labels and tab-bar labels only. 12px is the floor for any text.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Owner screens breathe: 64px between page sections on desktop, 44px on phones.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gaps inside tracks and dot rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between related lines; mobile card gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones; gap between cards in a rail.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding inside decision cards.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Padding of feature panels; section gap on phones.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Space above the greeting.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on desktop.

radius.note: Finished things are soft and rounded; planned things are square and drafted. The radius itself carries meaning.

tokens.name: radius-drafted
tokens.usage: Drafted (planned) shapes: the open seat, a course on the drawing board. Paired with the construction-line frame.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Logo tile, small inner blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Date tiles, portrait tiles inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Seats, inner panels, message bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards: decision, idea, person, panel.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Feature panels (spring readiness).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, nav tabs, tracks.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: White and surface cards on paper. Tinted cards carry no shadow.
